correctness.rationale: For every fixed N>=3 and positive threshold ratios the exact event integral follows by integrating the published NESS JPDF. Reflection yields H_b, with a global upper bound H_{aR}(R²u/D)<= (L/R)(pi u)^-1/2 exp(-a²/(4u)); S has the same bound without the exponential. This gives dominated convergence and an explicit gamma integral; layer cake proves the sharp moment threshold, including logarithmic boundary. The finite-threshold script independently verified 52 checks.

value.rationale: The established reset-gas model generates correlations without interactions. The new all-particle tail law quantifies nonvanishing joint extreme dependence even as displacement thresholds diverge. It gives the complete fixed-N moment phase boundary and an explicit Euclidean threshold geometry relevant to rare-event observables. This is distinct from a merely cosmetic reparameterization of an already reported mean or typical density.
